110	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
111	variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
112	
113	namespace DivisorAdaptation
114	
115	variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R pi d)
116	
117	omit [IsProper C.hom]
118	
119	/-- **Support containment upgrades to the fibrewise no-leak clause.** If the whole family
120	support lies in the piece `j`, then over every base point the fibre of the *closure* of the
121	piece trace stays in the piece: the trace is then all of the support, which is closed.
122	
123	This is the bridge between what the tube delivers (support containment over a shrunken
124	base) and what the certificate assembler consumes (the fibrewise clause of
125	`finite_colength_of_forall_fibre_closure_subset`). -/
126	theorem forall_fibre_closure_subset_of_supportLocus_subset (j : A.index)
127	    (hsub : d.supportLocus ⊆ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) :
128	    ∀ s : Spec (CommRingCat.of R),
129	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
130	          ∩ closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
131	        ⊆ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)) := by
132	  intro s x hx
133	  have htrace : d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)) = d.supportLocus :=
134	    Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hsub
135	  rw [htrace, d.isClosed_supportLocus.closure_eq] at hx
136	  exact hsub hx.2
137	
138	/-- The no-leak clause for **every** piece, from containment of the support in each: the
139	exact `hnoLeak` input of the certificate assemblers
140	(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning`,
141	`ThetaGeneratorSeed.divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning`). -/
142	theorem forall_noLeak_of_forall_supportLocus_subset
143	    (hsub : ∀ j : A.index, d.supportLocus ⊆ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) :
144	    ∀ (j : A.index) (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)),
145	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
146	          ∩ closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
147	        ⊆ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)) :=
148	  fun j => A.forall_fibre_closure_subset_of_supportLocus_subset j (hsub j)
149	
150	end DivisorAdaptation
151	
152	end NoLeakOverTube
153	
154	/-! ## The tube-fibre reduction
155	
156	Combining the two halves: to obtain the certificate assembler's `hnoLeak` input over an
157	`Away` chart, it is enough to check at ONE base prime that the support fibre lies in an
158	open — the tube spreads it to a basic-open neighbourhood, and containment there upgrades to
159	the fibrewise clause. This is the precise statement the remaining geometric work has to
160	feed, and it mentions only a single fibre. -/
161	
162	section TubeFibre
163	
164	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
165	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
166	
167	/-- **The tube-fibre reduction.** If at a base prime `p` the support fibre of the system
168	lies inside an open `U`, then some `r ∉ p` has the entire support over `D(r)` inside `U`.
169	
170	Stated so that the remaining certificate obligation is *purely fibrewise*: check one fibre,
171	get a Zariski chart.  The consumer chain is
172	`exists_notMem_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre` → the pulled system's support over `D(r)` →
173	`DivisorAdaptation.forall_noLeak_of_forall_supportLocus_subset` → the assembler's
174	`hnoLeak`, and then `isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation`
175	consumes the resulting away-certificate. -/
176	theorem exists_away_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre_subset
177	    (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (U : (relCurve C R).Opens) {p : PrimeSpectrum R}
178	    (hfib : ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹'
179	        {(p : Spec (CommRingCat.of R))} ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ (U : Set (relCurve C R))) :
180	    ∃ r : R, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
181	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹'
182	          (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) ∩ d.supportLocus
183	        ⊆ (U : Set (relCurve C R)) :=
184	  exists_notMem_supportLocus_subset_of_fibre C R d U.isOpen hfib
185	
186	end TubeFibre
187	
188	end AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme.LocalEquations

variable {X S : Scheme.{u}} (d : X.LocalEquations)

/-- **The leak locus of a support trace**: the part of the closure of
`supportLocus ∩ U` that escapes `U`.  The trace `supportLocus ∩ U` is closed in `X`
iff the leak locus is empty (`isClosed_supportLocus_inter_iff_supportLeak_eq_empty`);
its base image under a universally closed structure morphism is closed
(`isClosed_image_supportLeak`), so the trace is closed over the complementary base
open — the Zariski-local piece-isolation mechanism of the DDR-4 finiteness input. -/
def supportLeak (U : X.Opens) : Set X :=
  closure (d.supportLocus ∩ (U : Set X)) \ (U : Set X)

lemma isClosed_supportLeak (U : X.Opens) : IsClosed (d.supportLeak U) :=
  isClosed_closure.sdiff U.isOpen

/-- The leak locus lies in the support outside the open: leaks are support points. -/
lemma supportLeak_subset_sdiff (U : X.Opens) :
    d.supportLeak U ⊆ d.supportLocus \ (U : Set X) := fun _ hx =>
  ⟨closure_minimal Set.inter_subset_left d.isClosed_supportLocus hx.1, hx.2⟩

/-- The support trace on an open is closed in the whole space iff nothing leaks. -/
lemma isClosed_supportLocus_inter_iff_supportLeak_eq_empty (U : X.Opens) :
    IsClosed (d.supportLocus ∩ (U : Set X)) ↔ d.supportLeak U = ∅ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [supportLeak, h.closure_eq, Set.sdiff_eq_empty]
    exact Set.inter_subset_right
  · intro h
    rw [supportLeak, Set.sdiff_eq_empty] at h

330	/-! ### The colength modules and the glued equalizer -/
331	
332	/-- The chart-local colength module `Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)`, an `R`-algebra through
333	`Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra`. -/
334	noncomputable abbrev colength (j : A.index) : Type u :=
335	  Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⧸ Ideal.span {A.eqn j}
336	
337	/-- The symmetric overlap ideal: both equations restricted to the piece overlap. The
338	two restrictions generate the same ideal (the equations differ by units on overlaps
339	through the refinement witness), but the symmetric span needs no transport in the
340	DEFINITION. -/
341	noncomputable abbrev ovlIdeal (i j : A.index) :
342	    Ideal Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j) :=
343	  Ideal.span
344	    {relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_left : A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces i) (A.eqn i),
345	     relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_right : A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces j) (A.eqn j)}
346	
347	/-- The overlap colength module `Γ(D(h_i) ⊓ D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_i, f_j)`. -/
348	noncomputable abbrev ovlColength (i j : A.index) : Type u :=
349	  Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j) ⧸ A.ovlIdeal i j
350	
351	/-- The induced `R`-algebra map `colength i → ovlColength i j` (restrict, then quotient;
352	the ideal of `f_i` lands in the symmetric span). -/
353	noncomputable def toOvlLeft (i j : A.index) : A.colength i →ₐ[R] A.ovlColength i j :=
354	  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (Ideal.span {A.eqn i})
355	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (A.ovlIdeal i j)).comp (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_left))
356	    (by
357	      intro a ha
358	      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at ha
359	      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
360	      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
361	      have hmem : relResAlgHom C R
362	          (inf_le_left : A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces i) (A.eqn i)
363	          ∈ A.ovlIdeal i j :=
364	        Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
365	      rw [Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem, zero_mul])

body: 'THE Z-CLOPEN CERTIFICATE PRINCIPLE (DD-1/DD-2 lanes, 2026-07-17 — three independent
  sightings in one day; treat as a standing design constraint for every DAT-D brick).


  A DivisorAdaptation piece carries an R-finite-projective colength — clause (c1)
  of IsCertified — IFF the piece''s trace on the divisor scheme Z = V(D) (finite flat
  over Spec R) is CLOPEN in Z. Any construction that slices Z along the base (basic-open
  refinement of pieces, denominator-cleared pieces from a localization cover, Z-blind
  extraction) produces section rings like R_u that are NOT finite over R, and the
  certificate is unrecoverable — the localization-span descent lemmas'' hypotheses
  are FALSE, not merely hard. Canonical counterexample: R = k[u], zero-section divisor,
  cleared piece D(u-tilde): colength = R_u.


  Consequences adjudicated today: (1) the DD-1 pt-transport seam could NOT be fixed
  by extraction + certificate transport (certificates are not refinement-stable) —
  fixed instead by the S1 carrier surgery (point-free eqn_rel, total mapAlg, commit
  19c79359); (2) DD-2 S5''s glued adaptation could NOT take its certificate from denominator-cleared
  pieces (spec-dd-2 section-5 route corrected in the addendum) — the gluing keystone
  landed CONDITIONAL on hcert (exists_glue_of_away_compat_of_certifiedRep, commit
  1758fad90).


  THE MISSING BRICK (next in the DD-2 lane; coordinate with DD-R before speccing —
  same substrate as DDR-4''s engine bridge, spec-dd-r section-7 risk 1): W-as-algebra
  extraction — the glued colength W(d) of a certified family is a finite projective
  R-ALGEBRA (= Gamma(Z)); its canonical idempotents (glued via the module-localization
  sheaf sequence over the away cover) split Z into packets; CRT-separated chart generators
  give packet-swallowing basic-open pieces whose traces are clopen; that adaptation
  carries the certificate and discharges hcert, upgrading the conditional keystone
  to the pinned DivFam.exists_glue_of_away_compat. Only then can S6 deliver divFunctor
  at full strength for DDR-9.'
